title: feat(showcase): live bare-variant KPIs + brand palette on Command Center 大屏
body:
Makes the showcase **Command Center (大屏)** use the data-screen primitives added in objectstack-ai/objectui#1923, replacing the per-page workarounds with first-class props:

- **KPIs** → live `object-metric` `variant:'bare'` (big tinted numbers, data-bound) instead of hand-typed static `element:text` numbers. Budget uses compact `'0.0a'` → `1.1M`.
- **Charts** → `object-chart` `colors` brand palette (drops the `--chart-1..5` CSS-var override) + first-class `donut` chartType.

Bumps `.objectui-sha` to the objectui commit (`69e8cf2`) carrying those renderer capabilities.

**Depends on** objectstack-ai/objectui#1923 — merge that first so `.objectui-sha` resolves from objectui/main (it will be merged with a merge commit, keeping the pinned sha reachable).

Verified locally (re-vendored console, light + dark): live bare KPIs, cohesive palette via `colors`, scaling donut, gradient area, compact `1.1M` budget, 0 console errors.
